_comment: Read fresh on every run -- edit freely, no launchd reload needed.
_volume_allowlist: Empty = act on any external ejectable volume under /Volumes. Add names (e.g. ["Extreme SSD"]) to narrow it. Internal and boot disks are refused regardless.
_protected_processes: Never signalled. Spotlight/fseventsd/backupd release on their own when diskarbitrationd asks; killing them causes reindexing and broken Time Machine state for no benefit.
_graceful_handlers: Per-process overrides. 'pre' runs before the quit request (checkpoint/flush), 'wait' is the grace period in seconds. rqbit gets 20s so it can write out its torrent session state. Plex is a launchd job and is booted out; its plist's ExitTimeOut (300s) must exceed 'wait' or launchd kills it first.
_escalation: Never forced. Each holder is asked to quit the way it expects: launchd jobs are booted out (and bootstrapped again after the eject), app bundles get an AppleScript quit, everything else SIGTERM. If anything still holds the volume after the grace period the volume stays mounted and the notification names it. No diskutil unmount force, no SIGKILL, no flag for either.
_debounce_seconds: Finder fires several unmount solicitations per click; only the first is acted on.
